## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Vatican City, Vatican. It starts at 12 Piazza del Popolo.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> For over a decade, the Leonardo da Vinci Museum has been celebrating the Renaissance genius of Leonardo as an artist, but also as an inventor, scientist, anatomist, engineer and architect.
>
> Located in the basement of the Basilica of Santa Maria del Popolo, the museum is just a five-minute walk from the Spanish Steps and Villa Borghese, in the charming Piazza del Popolo.
>
> With your Leonardo da Vinci Museum tickets, you can discover interactive machines made by Italian craftsmen, based on Leonardo's manuscripts. Admire studies of some of his most famous Renaissance works, sketches of human anatomy, in-depth videos on _The Last Supper_ and _The Vitruvian Man_, and an immersive multimedia room that will take you on a journey into the life and mind of Leonardo da Vinci.
>
> Divided into themed areas on Leonardo's studies and passions, every year the museum welcomes thousands of visitors from all over the world, making it the most visited Leonardo da Vinci museum in Rome.

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €15.31. It was rated 4.3 out of 5 from 180 ratings and 90 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from
